chapter: Paris 1951-70 and return to New York
title: The Bordeaux wine festival gig and the million francs
summary: At a Bordeaux festival Butler overheard Cuban Pete counting a million francs but offering him ten thousand, and took more money by threatening to tell.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So he -- Cuban Pete, I was so giggin' he took me on a gig. One of the wine festivals. And (inaudible) says, I'm going to give you ten bills for this one. Room and board. Ten mill is the price for it. So we went to the West Coast of France, Bordeaux wine center. Get there and I'm happy and everything, the wine is so good that the wine give me pimples, the wine's so rich. And the food is so good.

But then it seems I went in the back room, to sort of rest myself, that wine was taking care of me. And I heard the man count five hundred, six hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred, nine hundred. (Inaudible).
God!" See, we were there a day and a half. I didn't say anything Yeah. I said, "Good) This man only want to give me ten francs, like one percent of what he's getting.
(Inaudible). So he'll give me ten thousand.

He was getting 100,000. And he only wanted to give me ten francs, I mean, 10,000. Which is no where near 100,000 francs. It was even a million, because I'm getting the old franc and the new franc mixed up. But at that time it was a million francs.
No, themoney changed. You got the old franc and the new franc. And like a million francs would be a thousand francs. The old franc was a million francs (inaudible).
So how much money would that have been in America?
Well, about $5,000.00. So I was getting about $22.00. So he was paying people off. So he had the money up there, yes, you did a nice job. One, two, ten thousand. I reached over and I got this.
You just took some more, huh?

"Butler, what are you doing?" I said, "I heard the man count over a million francs, man. Do you want me to tell anybody about it?" "You shouldn't be touching the money like that." And I said, "Well, that's what it is now. Do you want me to tell anybody about that million francs?" "Well, we'll have dinner, we'll talk about it." Good.

So he said, "Butler, I can't hire you never no more." I said, yes, but man, I come from New York. I didn't come from no island, no where. I come from the magic isle. Now, you know I'm going to find out what you're doing. (Unintelligible). Now, this here's how he starts the band, one, two, one, two, three, four, that's how you start the band. He says, "All right, let's go." And he would have the bongo beating on the -- let's go fellows, let's go. Whomp, whomp, whomp, whomp. So I saw that, and he's out in front of the band.
Yeah, something like that. But Buddy's a Musician.
Yeah, I know what you're saying. I'm just talking about in front of the rest of the band.
Yeah, he's out there, bump, bump, bump, bump. And he couldn't play but he had all kinds of costumes, he would change costumes.

He said, "Butler, you cannot work for us." I said, who said anything about working for you anymore? You ain't say, "You're smart." Everytime, he'd/ moving me out there." You're smart, too, because if I told them people you stole their money, (unintelligible).
